title: Conditional role composer: editor for scoped permissions and ephemeral grants
creator: Maya Chen
description: Problem: The current role editor in Console treats roles as static buckets (name + permission checklist). For RBAC v2 we need a more expressive editor that supports scoped permissions (resource/project/environment), conditional constraints (time windows, IP ranges, MFA requirement), and ephemeral grants (time-limited role bindings). Goals: 1) Enable admins to compose roles that can express attribute-based constraints without overwhelming novices; 2) Provide clear previews of effective permissions when constraints are applied; 3) Surface audit/logging and SSO implications inline; 4) Keep member assignment flows simple (bulk add, invite by SSO group, ephemeral assignment) and auditable. This ticket defines the UX surface and interaction patterns for the new "Conditional Role Composer" and a companion assignment modal for ephemeral grants.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Designer-proposed mocks for role composer (desktop + responsive) exist in Figma with flows for: base permissions, add constraint (resource/project/tag), add condition (time window, IP, require_mfa), and visual preview of effective permissions. 2) Member assignment modal shows options for permanent vs ephemeral binding, start/end dates, and SSO group lookup. 3) Inline help copy explaining audit visibility and how constraints affect logging. 4) Hand-off docs include annotated interaction states, keyboard accessibility notes, and copy for error states. 5) Engineering sign-off on complexity (estimate <= 8 pts).
decisions: Use a two-column editor: left column for role skeleton (name, description, base perms), right column for stacked constraints and preview. Chosen to preserve familiarity while surfacing new concepts.
Ephemeral grants implemented as separate assignment flow (modal) rather than a role attribute to reduce accidental expirations on shared roles.
Preview will show both 'Allow' and 'Deny' traces and a simple badge indicating 'restricted by condition' to keep edge-case details behind an expand control.
Expose SSO group mapping info inline when an SSO-provisioned user/group is selected; indicate whether permission comes from role binding or SSO claim mapping.
tradeoffs: Complexity vs discoverability: Combining constraints into the role editor avoids fragmentation but increases cognitive load. We mitigate by using progressive disclosure and templates.
Preview fidelity: full simulation of every possible resource tag is expensive. We'll provide a sample-scoped preview and a link to run a full evaluation in the infra console.
Temporality model: Allowing ephemeral grants reduces accidental long-lived access, but requires careful UX around reminding admins of upcoming expirations—adds notification surface.
test_plan: - Usability test with 6 platform admins to complete three tasks: create constrained role, assign ephemeral binding, interpret audit statement. - Accessibility audit for keyboard and screenreader (focus order, labels). - QA checklist: constraint validation, timezone handling for time windows, SSO group lookup latency handling, optimistic UI for assignment. - Instrument events: composer_open, constraint_add, preview_open, assign_ephemeral_submitted.
